extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor seeks around £21,000 to pay inheritance tax on his late father's estate, mainly a Guildford house valued at about £696,000, before the grant of probate can be issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax on your late father's estate. We have noted that the estate is principally a property in Guildford valued at around £696,000, with limited cash, and that you are seeking approximately £21,000. To take this further we would need confirmation of your appointment as executor, a copy of the will, the death certificate, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, the property valuation and details of any mortgage or charge, plus the IHT figures and your solicitor's contact details at Lockwood & Ueda Legal. Please also let us know if there is a date by which the tax must be paid. Once we have those documents a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
